lessons.title: Lessons (newest first, keep under 30 lines; prune stale ones)
items: 2026-10-26: Roundup on 10/23 went out without our note (log 16:17:44): the close-wrap routine fires at 4:17 PM, the same minute as the roundup, so the note wasn't ready (it was only written 10/24 10:20). The note must exist before ~4:15 PM, or the close wrap needs to move.

2026-10-23: Week 10/19–23 scorecard: 7 up / 7 down / 3 flat, avg +0.46% per call vs SPY −0.9%. Energy (SLB, HAL), defense (LMT) and clean beat-and-raises (DDOG, MMM) worked; gap chases and close re-affirms lost.
2026-10-23: Big headline gaps fade from the open (CCI +7.6% pre → −5.5% from open, still +9% C/C). For a pre-market gap >5%, either skip or log the idea at the close, not the open.
2026-10-23: Close "hold" re-affirms after a +5% day lost again (TMO −2.9%, PG −2.1%). Don't log them as new calls; just keep the original line open.
2026-10-23: Forward tests keep showing LLM-built strategies lose to dumb benchmarks out of sample (Quant-Arena, crypto study). Lab winners must beat SPY and equal-weight on a sealed hold-out.
2026-10-16: Re-affirming a winner after a big multi-day run bought the top; once a name is +5% in a week, hold it but don't re-add.
2026-10-16: A swing long on a crowded AI theme (LITE, ASML) failed fast when the sector cracked; when a group goes into avoid, pull open swing ideas in it the same day.
2026-10-16: Grade swing calls mark-to-market each Friday from the actual entry (open for pre-market calls, close for close calls); keep "open" until horizon ends.
2026-10-09: Sector shocks need whole-group avoids. SpaceX hits on telcos (10/9 and again 10/23, T/TMUS −8%) validated bundling telcos; towers (AMT/CCI) are the long read-through.
2026-10-09: Oil-premium swings reverse fast on de-escalation headlines; keep confidence low and horizon honest.
Keep briefs short and ranked by expected impact; Tendies and Dip needs decisions, not volume.
Every claim needs a source link and a timestamp; never guess prices.
Day desk is closed (no edge); put idea effort into swing / overnight long-only with published evidence.

RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-10-29)
- Alphabet had its worst day ever, down about 12.6% on a rare double miss and negative free cash flow, pulling the Nasdaq down 1.4% while the S&P 500 and Dow slipped only 0.3%. Most stocks actually rose, and small caps gained about 0.8%.
- Amazon then missed on earnings and revenue after the bell and fell more than 7% in late trading, so AI-spending worries are now the story into Apple next week.
- Our avoids paid: ServiceNow fell about 26% and Fortinet about 22% by midday, and Caterpillar dropped about 9%. Eli Lilly, our top idea, rose about 6% on its beat and raised guidance, while Microsoft gave back its early gain.
- Data was mixed: growth was strong at 3.4% but September inflation rose to 3.6%, and the 10-year yield eased to just under 5%.
- Tomorrow brings Exxon earnings before the open and the employment cost report at 8:30 AM. We moved Amazon from hold to avoid and pulled Datadog as software keeps cracking.
